title: Рассказ с фоном и событием
description: Соединяем фоновые действия и короткие события в понятном рассказе.
objectives: Различать Past Continuous и Past Simple
notes: Past Continuous показывает процесс в определённый момент прошлого.
Past Simple часто обозначает событие, которое прерывает фоновое действие.

public_payload.sentence: I ___ home when my phone rang.

exercises.explanation: Was walking описывает процесс, во время которого зазвонил телефон.

exercises.prompt: Вставь прошедшую форму be для they.

public_payload.sentence: They ___ waiting outside when the doors opened.

exercises.editorial_answer: They were waiting outside when the doors opened.
exercises.explanation: С they используется were в Past Continuous.

exercises.prompt: Почему Эмма сначала не заметила остановку автобуса?

options.label: She had already left the bus.
She was talking to the driver the whole time.
She was looking at a message on her phone.

public_payload.passage: Emma was travelling home after a long day. She was reading a message on her phone while the bus was moving through the town centre. When she looked up, she realised that the bus had stopped at a different place because the usual road was closed. She asked the driver how to reach her street.

exercises.editorial_answer: She was looking at a message on her phone.
exercises.explanation: В начале Emma was reading a message, поэтому не следила за остановкой.

exercises.editorial_answer: I was cooking when the lights went out.
exercises.explanation: Was cooking — фон; went out — краткое событие, прервавшее его.

public_payload.sentence: We was having lunch when she arrived.

accepted: We were having lunch when she arrived.

exercises.reference_answer: We were having lunch when she arrived.
exercises.incorrect_answer: We are having lunch when she arrives.
exercises.editorial_answer: We were having lunch when she arrived.
exercises.explanation: После we нужна were; обе части остаются в прошлом.

exercises.prompt: Выбери объяснение того, что происходило в момент звонка.

options.label: I will take a shower tomorrow.
I take a shower every day.

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.text: Why didn’t you answer the phone at eight?

exercises.explanation: Was taking описывает процесс в указанный прошлый момент.

exercises.prompt: Переведи фразу о двух одновременных действиях в прошлом.

accepted: While I was cooking, she was reading.
She was reading while I was cooking.

exercises.reference_answer: While I was cooking, she was reading.
exercises.incorrect_answer: While I am cooking, she is reading.
exercises.editorial_answer: While I was cooking, she was reading.
exercises.explanation: Оба процесса относятся к прошлому: was cooking и was reading.

exercises.prompt: Повтори значение слова suddenly в рассказе.
